Verify actual Ubuntu evidence and honest unresolved-gate disposition
Install contract dependencies and worker confinement library
Verify successor generator release identity and packaged tzdb
Enable authoritative PostgreSQL commit evidence for idempotency
Compile both complete approved domains through the negotiated target
Verify identity clearing and logical recovery keys
Verify exact HTTP outcomes through the production browser
Verify actual sealed 0.3 upgrade without database changes
Verify isolated typed components without claiming target admission
Verify approved Canonical 0.3 invocation runtime against PostgreSQL and HTTP

Verify approved Canonical 0.2 and ChangeSet 0.2 evolution boundaries

Preserve closure recommendation and complete evidence
